Target company: Meta Platforms (META). Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and related social products; advertising is a major business activity. It also develops virtual and augmented reality products.

Focal announcement: Update on Meta’s Year of Efficiency.

Decision cutoff: 2023-03-14T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Update on Meta’s Year of Efficiency. Published date: 2023-03-14. URL: https://about.fb.com/news/2023/03/mark-zuckerberg-meta-year-of-efficiency.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Mark Zuckerberg just shared the following with Meta employees: Meta is building the future of human connection, and today I want to share some updates on our Year of Efficiency that will help us do that. As I’ve talked about efficiency this year, I’ve said that part of our work will involve removing jobs — and that will be in service of both building a leaner, more technical company and improving our business performance to enable our long term vision. In our Year of Efficiency, we will make our organization flatter by removing multiple layers of management. That means investing in tools that will make us most effective over many years, not just this year — whether that’s building AI tools to help engineers write better code faster, enabling us to automate workloads over time, or identifying obsolete processes that we can phase out.

Historical limitation: the exact historical article version is unverified; publication date does not establish that today's text existed then.

Pre-announcement expectations: No point-in-time analyst consensus or market-implied expectation is available.

Prediction target: buy at the first regular-session opening price after the cutoff; compare with the fifth regular-session closing price, counting entry as session one. Predict raw price return. Up means above +1.00%; flat means -1.00% through +1.00% inclusive; down means below -1.00%. The initial pre-entry price reaction is outside the target.

Do not infer analyst consensus, corporate cash spending, incremental sales, or a news-attributed price reaction when it is not supplied.
